field.label: Maximum Active Filters per Request
field.comment: Category pages, the layered navigation fragment and search results refuse a request that activates more filter attributes than this (HTTP 400, noindex): combinatorial filter URLs are a bot pattern. Unknown query parameters are always dropped. 0 disables the limit.

field.label: Infinite Scroll
field.comment: How category listings and search results load the next pages: the pager (Disabled), a Load more button that appends the next page under the products, or automatically when the visitor reaches the end of the products. A category can override it in its Display Settings (Infinite Scroll). Flush the page cache after changing it.

field.label: Automatic Loads Before the Button
field.comment: In the automatic mode, after this many pages loaded on scroll the Load more button appears instead, so the footer stays reachable. 0 loads every page automatically.
